objective.en: When the room shakes, pick the safest cover, hold on until it stops, then walk out the safe way.
objective.fil: Kapag yumanig ang silid, piliin ang pinakaligtas na kanlungan, kumapit hanggang tumigil, saka lumabas sa ligtas na daan.

howTo.en: Let go when the shaking stops, then pick the safe exit
howTo.fil: Bumitaw kapag tumigil ang yanig, saka piliin ang ligtas na labasan

takeaway.en: When the ground shakes: Drop, Cover, Hold, and stay put until it stops.
takeaway.fil: Kapag yumanig ang lupa: Dumapa, Magtakip, Kumapit, at manatili hanggang tumigil ito.

objective.en: Dodge falling ash and rocks, grab your mask and goggles, keep away from the lahar river, and leave when the alert says go.
objective.fil: Iwasan ang bumabagsak na abo at bato, kunin ang mask at goggles, lumayo sa ilog ng lahar, at umalis kapag sinabi ng alerto.

howTo.en: Catch the safety gear, dodge the ash
howTo.fil: Saluhin ang gamit pangkaligtasan, iwasan ang abo

takeaway.en: During ashfall: mask on, goggles on, stay indoors, and leave right away when told to evacuate.
takeaway.fil: Habang may ashfall: magsuot ng mask at goggles, manatili sa loob, at umalis agad kapag pinalikas.

objective.en: The sea pulled back. Run uphill to high ground, jumping and sliding past obstacles, before the wave arrives.
objective.fil: Umurong ang dagat. Tumakbo paakyat sa mataas na lugar, tumalon at dumausdos sa mga harang, bago dumating ang alon.

howTo.fil: Tumalon (pindutin nang matagal para mas mataas)

takeaway.en: If the ground shakes or the sea pulls back, run to high ground. Don't wait, and don't go back.
takeaway.fil: Kapag yumanig ang lupa o umurong ang dagat, tumakbo sa mataas na lugar. Huwag maghintay at huwag bumalik.

objective.en: Plant trees and dig canals to slow the mud, watch for warning signs, and get the village out early.
objective.fil: Magtanim ng puno at maghukay ng kanal para mapabagal ang putik, bantayan ang mga babala, at ilikas nang maaga ang barangay.

takeaway.en: Cracks, tilting trees, muddy water? Tell an adult and move to safety. Don't wait for the slope to fall.
takeaway.fil: May bitak, nakatagilid na puno, maputik na tubig? Sabihin sa nakatatanda at lumikas. Huwag hintaying gumuho ang dalisdis.

objective.en: Fit every essential into the go bag before the storm signal rises. Space is tight, so safety items come first.
objective.fil: Ipagkasya ang lahat ng mahalaga sa go bag bago tumaas ang signal ng bagyo. Masikip, kaya unahin ang gamit pangkaligtasan.

takeaway.en: Pack what keeps you safe, not what's fun. A go bag should be ready before the signal goes up.
takeaway.fil: Iimpake ang nagpapanatiling ligtas, hindi ang pampalibang. Dapat handa ang go bag bago tumaas ang signal.

objective.en: The flood is rising. Switch off the power, move things and family upstairs, and leave when the evacuation order comes.
objective.fil: Tumataas ang baha. Patayin ang kuryente, iakyat ang gamit at pamilya, at umalis kapag may utos na lumikas.

howTo.en: Do the most urgent task first

takeaway.en: Power off, move up, and never walk through floodwater. Leave when you're told to.
takeaway.fil: Patayin ang kuryente, umakyat, at huwag lumusong sa baha. Umalis kapag pinalikas.

objective.en: Drive the rescue vehicle through town, pick up families (those who need help first) and bring them inland before the surge.
objective.fil: Imaneho ang sasakyang pansagip, sunduin ang mga pamilya (unahin ang nangangailangan) at dalhin sila sa loob bago dumating ang daluyong.

howTo.en: Pick up people at the houses
howTo.fil: Sunduin ang mga tao sa bahay

howTo.en: Bring them to the evacuation center

takeaway.en: Storm surge can rise faster than you can run. Coastal families must leave early, and help those who need it first.
takeaway.fil: Mas mabilis tumaas ang daluyong kaysa sa takbo mo. Dapat umalis nang maaga ang mga nasa baybayin, at unahin ang nangangailangan.

objective.en: Turn the pipes so water reaches drinking taps first, fix leaks, and reuse water so no drop is wasted.
objective.fil: Ikutin ang mga tubo para maunang makarating ang tubig sa inuman, ayusin ang tagas, at gamiting muli ang tubig.

takeaway.en: In a drought, every drop counts: fix leaks, reuse water, and drink enough to stay cool.
takeaway.fil: Sa tagtuyot, mahalaga ang bawat patak: ayusin ang tagas, gamiting muli ang tubig, at uminom nang sapat.

objective.en: Help the health center by unscrambling health words: washing hands, covering coughs, vaccines and rest.
objective.fil: Tulungan ang health center sa pag-aayos ng ginulong salitang pangkalusugan: paghuhugas ng kamay, pagtakip sa ubo, bakuna at pahinga.

howTo.en: Type letters or tap the tiles
howTo.fil: Mag-type ng letra o pindutin ang tiles

howTo.en: Pause (P and H are letters here)
howTo.fil: Huminto (letra ang P at H dito)

takeaway.en: Wash hands, cover coughs, get vaccinated, and stay home when sick — that's how outbreaks stop.
takeaway.fil: Maghugas ng kamay, takpan ang ubo, magpabakuna, at manatili sa bahay kapag may sakit — ganyan napipigil ang outbreak.

objective.en: Match each pest to the sickness it spreads and the way to stop it, and clean out mosquito breeding spots.
objective.fil: Itugma ang bawat peste sa sakit na dala nito at sa paraan ng pagpigil, at linisin ang pinamumugaran ng lamok.

howTo.en: Move, then flip or select a card
howTo.fil: Gumalaw, saka magbukas o pumili ng card

howTo.en: World 2: drag each fix onto its pest (Enter picks and places, Esc puts back)
howTo.fil: Mundo 2: i-drag ang bawat lunas sa peste nito (Enter pumili at ilagay, Esc ibalik)

howTo.en: Shuffle the Onet board (2 per level)
howTo.fil: Haluin ang Onet board (2 bawat antas)

takeaway.en: No standing water, covered food, clean surroundings — pests can't spread what they can't breed.
takeaway.fil: Walang naiipong tubig, takip ang pagkain, malinis ang paligid — hindi kakalat ang pesteng hindi makapamugad.

objective.en: Follow the exit signs out of the smoky building: stay low, feel doors before opening, use the stairs, and reach the assembly area.
objective.fil: Sundan ang exit signs palabas ng mausok na gusali: yumuko, damhin ang pinto bago buksan, gumamit ng hagdan, at pumunta sa assembly area.

howTo.en: Open the door / alert a classmate
howTo.fil: Buksan ang pinto / tawagin ang kaklase

howTo.en: Stop, drop and roll (when a spark lands)
howTo.fil: Huminto, dumapa at gumulong (kapag may tilamsik)

takeaway.en: Get low, feel the door, use the stairs, and go straight to the assembly area.
takeaway.fil: Yumuko, damhin ang pinto, gumamit ng hagdan, at dumiretso sa assembly area.

objective.en: Slide the fallen blocks to clear a way out, without moving the ones that hold the roof up, then signal for help.
objective.fil: Idulas ang mga bumagsak na bloke para makalabas, nang hindi ginagalaw ang sumusuporta sa bubong, saka humingi ng tulong.

takeaway.en: Leave a damaged building right away. If you're trapped: cover your mouth, stay still, and tap or whistle for help.
takeaway.fil: Lumabas agad sa sirang gusali. Kung naipit: takpan ang bibig, manatiling kalmado, at kumatok o pumito para humingi ng tulong.

objective.en: Get to school safely: stop at the curb, look both ways, use the pedestrian lane and footbridge, and wait for the walk signal.
objective.fil: Makarating nang ligtas sa paaralan: huminto sa gilid, tumingin sa magkabilang direksiyon, gumamit ng pedestrian lane at footbridge, at hintayin ang signal.

howTo.en: Swipe to go sideways or back
Wait at the curb to look left and right (no button)
howTo.fil: Maghintay sa gilid para tumingin sa kaliwa at kanan (walang pindutan)

takeaway.en: Stop, look left and right, and cross at the pedestrian lane — your phone can wait.
takeaway.fil: Huminto, tumingin sa kaliwa at kanan, at tumawid sa pedestrian lane — makapaghihintay ang cellphone mo.

title.fil: Jigsaw ng mga Simbolo ng Panganib

objective.en: Put hazard signs back together, learn what each one means, and choose what to do when you see a spill.
objective.fil: Buuin muli ang mga senyales ng panganib, alamin ang ibig sabihin, at piliin ang gagawin kapag may natapon.

takeaway.en: See a spill or a hazard sign? Don't touch it, move upwind, and tell an adult.
takeaway.fil: May natapon o senyales ng panganib? Huwag hawakan, lumipat sa pinanggagalingan ng hangin, at sabihin sa nakatatanda.

objective.en: Compare the safe room with the risky one, find every electrical hazard, and choose the right fix.
objective.fil: Ihambing ang ligtas na silid sa mapanganib, hanapin ang lahat ng panganib sa kuryente, at piliin ang tamang ayos.

takeaway.en: Never touch a fallen wire, keep water away from plugs, and tell an adult when something looks wrong.
takeaway.fil: Huwag hawakan ang nahulog na kawad, ilayo ang tubig sa saksakan, at sabihin sa nakatatanda kapag may mali.

title.fil: Lost and Found: Misyon sa Mall

objective.en: Separated from your family? Stay where you are, find a safe helper in the crowd, and tell them your name and your parent's number.
objective.fil: Nahiwalay sa pamilya? Manatili sa kinaroroonan, humanap ng ligtas na katulong sa dami ng tao, at sabihin ang pangalan mo at numero ng magulang.

takeaway.en: Lost? Stop, stay, find a safe helper, and tell them your name and your parent's number.
takeaway.fil: Nawawala? Huminto, manatili, humanap ng ligtas na katulong, at sabihin ang pangalan mo at numero ng magulang.

objective.en: Walk with the crowd and edge toward the side to reach the exit with your buddy. Don't push, and don't stop for dropped things.
objective.fil: Sumabay sa dami ng tao at unti-unting tumabi papunta sa labasan kasama ang buddy mo. Huwag manulak at huwag huminto para pulutin ang nahulog.

howTo.en: Arms in front: protect your chest
howTo.fil: Braso sa harap: protektahan ang dibdib

howTo.en: Follow the marshals to the exit
howTo.fil: Sundin ang mga marshal papuntang labasan

takeaway.en: In a crowd: walk, don't push, move with the flow toward the side, and never stop to pick things up.
takeaway.fil: Sa dami ng tao: maglakad, huwag manulak, sumabay sa agos patungo sa gilid, at huwag huminto para pumulot.

objective.en: Seat everyone at lunch so nobody is left out, follow the table rules, and choose how to be an upstander.
objective.fil: Paupuin ang lahat sa tanghalian para walang maiwan, sundin ang patakaran sa mesa, at piliin kung paano maging upstander.

takeaway.en: Be an upstander: include others, don't join in, and tell a trusted adult.
takeaway.fil: Maging upstander: isali ang iba, huwag makisali sa pang-aapi, at sabihin sa pinagkakatiwalaang nakatatanda.

objective.en: Sort messages: share what comes from trusted sources, and stop rumours before they spread.
objective.fil: Iuri ang mga mensahe: ibahagi ang galing sa mapagkakatiwalaan, at pigilan ang tsismis bago kumalat.

howTo.en: Trusted message or safe action: send it right
howTo.fil: Mapagkakatiwalaang mensahe o ligtas na gawain: ipadala pakanan

howTo.en: Rumour or unsafe action: send it left (check first)
howTo.fil: Tsismis o hindi ligtas: ipadala pakaliwa (suriin muna)

howTo.en: Say how you feel at the end

takeaway.en: Stay calm, stay inside with family, listen to trusted adults — and check before you share.
takeaway.fil: Manatiling kalmado, manatili sa loob kasama ang pamilya, makinig sa pinagkakatiwalaang nakatatanda — at suriin bago ibahagi.
